'''Deefourfive''' was a silver [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] employed by the [[One Sith]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[41 ABY]] to receive agents of the One Sith into their presence. Deefourfive met the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Kell Douro]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and took him to see [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]].
